title: Abiyeguriye Imana basezeranye
intro: Umuhanuzi wubahwaga yagendaga mu bantu, abahamagarira kwerekeza ku kuri. Benshi barahindukiriye bagomanze, ariko itsinda rito ryiyeguriye Imana ryitabiriye umuhamagaro maze risezeranya ribikuye ku mutima. Bageragejwe n'ibibazo byo gushidikanya kandi batinyuka gushaka ibibatunga byo mu ijuru. Ubwitange bwabo butajegajega bwabaye isomo ridashira mu kwizera. Bari bande?
clues: Twari itsinda rito ryahagurutse kugira ngo rishyigikire ubutumwa bw'Imana mu gihe cy'ubutemera bwari bukwirakwiriye hose.
Intumwa yubahwa yaraje iduhamagarira guhagarara nk'inshuti mu mugambi wa Allah.
Igihe umuhanuzi yabazaga abazaba abashyigikiye Imana, twasubije tudashidikanya.
Twatinyutse gusaba ibirori by'igitangaza biturutse mu ijuru kugira ngo bidukomereze imitima.
Intumwa yacu yatwibukije kubaha Allah niba twari abizera nyakuri, ariko ubusabe bwacu bwo kwicisha bugufi bwarubahirijwe.
Twari itsinda ry’abantu b’imbere b’indahemuka basezeranye ukwizera kutajegajega hamwe na Isa, mwene Mariyamu.

trial.label: Igeragezwa/Ikibazo
options: Gusabwa kuba abashyigikira umugambi wa Allah
Guhungira mu buvumo kugira ngo uhunge itotezwa
Kwambuka uruzi kugira ngo ugerageze kumvira
trial.answer: Gusabwa kuba abashyigikira umugambi wa Allah

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوٓا۟ أَنصَارَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّـۧنَ مَنْ أَنصَارِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَـَٔامَنَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَكَفَرَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ ۖ فَأَيَّدْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ عَلَىٰ عَدُوِّهِمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ ظَـٰهِرِينَ
verse: O you who have believed, be supporters of Allāh, as when Jesus, the son of Mary, said to the disciples, "Who are my supporters for Allāh?" The disciples said, "We are supporters of Allāh." And a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved. So We supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became dominant. (61:14)
